svg.text: SONIC-Academy · illustrated action guide
Unpack and configure PHP
Teaching diagram · not a screenshot or actual terminal result
APP01 · File Explorer and Notepad as administrator
For a fresh install, use the official PHP 8.4 x64 Non Thread Safe runtime ZIP, version 8.4.27
or a newer patched 8.4 release. Install Microsoft Visual C++ x64 Redistributable. Right-click
the ZIP → Extract All; put its contents directly in C:\PHP, so C:\PHP\php-cgi.exe exists. If
C:\PHP already contains a working runtime, do not overwrite it: use the later Update PHP and
Recover Safely class instead.
Copy php.ini-production to php.ini. Open php.ini and set extension_dir="C:\PHP\ext". Enable the
supplied mysqli, mbstring, intl, gd and fileinfo extensions by removing their leading
semicolons. Enable openssl if supplied and needed for TLS mail. Do not download random
extension DLLs.
Set date.timezone="UTC", log_errors=On, display_errors=Off and cgi.fix_pathinfo=1. Keep PHP
files outside the website root. Save and run the checks.
Also set session.save_path="C:\Sites\HelpdeskRuntime\sessions",
upload_tmp_dir="C:\Sites\HelpdeskRuntime\uploads" and error_log="C:\Sites\HelpdeskRuntime\php-
errors.log". We will create and permission those private runtime folders when we create the
pool.
Check: The selected 8.4 runtime is at least 8.4.27, its published ZIP hash matches, and the
required extensions load without warnings.
